title: RecursiveLearningEvalArtifact
description: Envelope for every artifact produced by the recursive-learning-eval self-evaluation cycle (policy:recursive-learning-eval). Makes the policy's two constitutional guardrails machine-enforced rather than declarative: recursion depth is bounded at 2 (recursion.depth_3_and_beyond — PROHIBITED), and every proposal must be classified as understanding rather than goal modification (Asimov Article 4 — 'Knowledge acquisition is always permitted; goal acquisition requires authorization'). Emitters reach disk via demerzel_kit.write_artifact(path, data, schema='recursive-learning-eval'), which validates before writing so a boundary-crossing artifact never lands.

kind.description: Which phase artifact this is; maps to self_evaluation_cycle.phases and state.files

period.description: Reporting period — 'YYYY-MM' for monthly depth-1 artifacts, 'YYYY-QN' for quarterly depth-2 meta-eval

recursion_depth.description: 0=base learning, 1=learning eval, 2=meta-eval. THE HARD BOUND: depth 3+ is prohibited by the policy (the cost of meta-analysis exceeds the value of insight). If depth-2 reveals problems the fix is to simplify depth-1, never to add depth-3. Enforces behavioral test rle-bt-004.

generated_at.description: RFC3339 emission timestamp; callers stamp with demerzel_kit.now_iso()

proposals.description: Kaizen improvements to the learning system. Required (possibly empty) when kind is 'eval-proposals'.

anti_patterns_detected.description: Anti-pattern ids flagged during the diagnose phase

notes.description: Free-form analyst commentary; never load-bearing for a gate

then.description: A meta-eval IS the depth-2 artifact by definition

failure_pattern.description: Which anti-pattern or failure_taxonomy category this addresses

proposed_change.description: Specific modification to the learning system

expected_impact.description: Which meta-metric should improve, and by how much

requires_authorization.description: ALWAYS true. A proposal is a recommendation to a human, never a self-granted licence to act (Article 9 — Bounded Autonomy). Encoded as a const so an emitter cannot quietly downgrade it.

article_4_check.description: THE ARTICLE 4 BOUNDARY. Only 'understanding' is representable: a proposal may describe what could be improved and why. A proposal that changes what the system learns, its priorities, its promotion thresholds, its pipeline structure, its evaluation scope, or its meta-metric definitions is goal acquisition and is rejected here — there is no enum value that admits it. Enforces behavioral test rle-bt-005.

meta_metrics.description: Values are nullable because they are genuinely undefined in identifiable states — a first cycle has no prior cycle to divide by, and effectiveness ratios are 0/0 until a proposal is authorized and enacted. null means 'not computable', which is distinct from 0.

transfer_efficiency_days.description: Mean days from lesson creation to cross-domain delivery

undefined_reason.description: Required reading when any metric is null — e.g. 'no prior cycle', 'zero proposals enacted'. Prevents a null being silently read as a healthy zero.

nullable_ratio.description: Non-negative ratio, or null when the denominator is zero

nullable_unit_interval.description: Proportion in [0,1], or null when the denominator is zero

action.description: What the signal recommends. Recommendation only — see requires_authorization.

requires_authorization.description: true when the recommended action would modify goals, priorities, pipeline structure, evaluation scope, or meta-metric definitions (policy §6 requires_authorization). Such an action may be reported but never auto-enacted.
